name: 9/11 Authorized Bus Parking Permit
description:
This dataset contains records of authorized bus parking permits issued in connection with 9/11, covering 3,914 sampled rows across 22 columns. Each record represents a permit issued to a bus company, with details including the permit year (2011–2026), permit and reservation numbers, valid and issue dates, scheduled bus arrival times, company name, city, state, and ZIP code, vehicle type (mostly motorcoach, with some school buses and mini-buses), number of buses, permit quantity, and whether the permit was returned along with the return date. It also includes condition restrictions, such as whether a paid meter receipt is required.

The data can be used to analyze permit issuance and bus traffic patterns over time, examine which companies and vehicle types participated, track permit returns and compliance with conditions, and study the geographic distribution of operators by city and state. It could also support planning, auditing, and historical research on transportation related to 9/11 events.
